mongoFix: The first signed-in attempts failed because mongo:7 aborted on the 256 MB tmpfs: three preallocated 100 MB WiredTiger journal files filled it, and the next write (FTDC, then an index build) was fatal. The A2-A4 signed-out pass had only been lucky about timing. Fixed with diagnosticDataCollectionEnabled=false, wiredTigerCacheSizeGB 0.25 and log=(file_max=20MB,prealloc=false): ~21 MB used. Signed-out rerun after the fix: verified, 29 s.
